global_config_admin_all.name: global_config_admin_all
global_config_admin_all.using:
EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM profiles
  WHERE profiles.id = (select auth.uid())
    AND profiles.role = 'admin'
)
global_config_admin_all.withCheck:
EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM profiles
  WHERE profiles.id = (select auth.uid())
    AND profiles.role = 'admin'
)
